children: Bodega Market now lets users bet on whether RealFi’s Cardano stablecoin reaches $1 million in deposits on Strike Finance. Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson called for the bet while its Strike market lists a yield near 50%.
However, the yield-bearing token earning that rate absorbs portfolio losses before ordinary holders do.
What Backs a Cardano Stablecoin Paying Near 50%?
RealFi issues USDrf, a dollar-pegged token backed by
. The team says direct lending to businesses forms the core of the portfolio, alongside Treasury bills and floating-rate bonds.

Holders of the Cardano stablecoin can stake it for sUSDrf, whose value moves with that portfolio. According to RealFi’s code submission on GitHub, protocol reserves take losses first, followed by sUSDrf holders.

Strike Finance, a Cardano perpetual futures exchange, also lets users borrow against deposited assets. It now accepts sUSDrf as collateral. Its dashboard listed a 49.31% APR, with roughly $119,200 in loans backed by the token.

By comparison, three-month US Treasury bills yielded about 4.3% on October 15, Federal Reserve data shows. Strike also allows a maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratio of 100%, so users can borrow the collateral’s full value.
Yet RealFi’s website does not explain how the yield behind that rate is generated.
Why Bettors Now Track a Single Vault
On October 17, Strike said its vault held close to $100,000 of the Cardano stablecoin. Within an hour, it reported another $50,000 in deposits.

children: Hoskinson then asked who would list a market on the vault hitting $1 million. He tagged Bodega, which bills itself as Cardano’s prediction market. Later, Bodega confirmed the market was live.

Still, ownership remains concentrated. On October 8, a single holder controlled about 66% of RealFi’s staking vault, the GitHub filing shows. That vault held roughly 2.58 million USDrf. A $1 million mark on Strike would therefore place a large share of that supply on one outside app.

Beyond one vault, Cardano is courting regulated finance, from a new token compliance standard to partnerships in Brazil. Consequently, the $1 million bet tests whether Cardano stablecoin deposits keep growing at current yields. It also shows whether they spread beyond a few large holders.

title: Cardano Stablecoin Offers 50% APR. What's the Catch?
